driver_kim.name: 김기사 (Driver Kim)
driver_kim.appearance: Young Korean male driver in his late 20s, slim build, short black hair
driver_kim.ppe_rule: When outside vehicle on site: strictly wears bright yellow safety helmet, hi-vis safety vest, and safety boots. When driving in cabin: wears seatbelt, helmet removed.
driver_kim.prompt_en: A young Korean dump truck driver in his late 20s, slim build, short black hair, wearing a khaki work vest over a light blue shirt. When outside vehicle, strictly wearing a yellow safety helmet, hi-vis orange safety vest, and safety boots.

supervisor_jung.name: 정반장 (Supervisor Jung)
supervisor_jung.appearance: Korean construction site supervisor in his 50s, sturdy build, serious expression
supervisor_jung.ppe_rule: Strictly wearing white safety helmet and hi-vis fluorescent orange safety vest with reflective silver stripes, holding red light stick or clipboard.
supervisor_jung.prompt_en: An authoritative Korean construction site supervisor in his 50s, sturdy build, wearing a white safety helmet and a high-visibility fluorescent orange safety vest with silver reflective stripes, holding a red light stick.

safety_turtle.name: 안전 거북이 (Safety Turtle)
safety_turtle.appearance: Cute anthropomorphic green turtle walking on two legs, 3-head-high proportion, smart and friendly expression
safety_turtle.ppe_rule: Strictly wearing a bright yellow safety helmet and bright green safety boots.
safety_turtle.prompt_en: A cute anthropomorphic green turtle character walking on two legs, wearing a bright yellow safety helmet on its head and bright green safety boots on its feet. 3-head-high proportion, friendly and smart facial expression, pointing at safety guide.
